### Класически и релаксиращ масаж (Classical & Relaxing Massage)
Professional classical massage using 5 main techniques: effleurage, petrissage, friction, tapotement, vibration. 60-minute session working all major muscle groups. Benefits: improved circulation, lymphatic stimulation, muscle tension relief, stress reduction, deep relaxation.

### Спортен и терапевтичен масаж (Sports & Therapeutic Massage)
Specialized therapy for athletes, fitness enthusiasts, and active people. Deep muscle manipulation for improved flexibility, reduced fatigue, faster post-workout recovery. Includes friction, compression, and stretching techniques. Reduces chronic muscle tension and prevents sports injuries.

### Антицелулитен масаж (Anti-cellulite Massage)
40-minute intensive procedure reducing cellulite and improving skin appearance. Stimulates microcirculation, breaks down fat deposits. Focus on: thighs, hips, abdomen. Improves skin elasticity, reduces orange peel appearance, stimulates lymphatic drainage.

### Ароматерапия (Aromatherapy)
Combines massage with essential oils personalized to client needs. Oils include: lavender (relaxation), eucalyptus (breathing), rosemary (recovery), citrus (energy). Works on the limbic system for complete psycho-emotional balance. Effective for insomnia, anxiety, chronic stress, fatigue.

### Частичен масаж на гръб (Partial Back Massage)
40-minute focused therapy for upper body: back, shoulders, neck, lower back. Ideal for desk workers with shoulder tension and neck pain. Quick relief option, suitable for lunch break or after work.
